title: Weave Ceremony — rich
forward_vector: I am the manifest of Weave Ceremony's rich face: what was made for each section, and the fingerprint of the words each piece was made against, so the page can say when a piece may lag the text. I grow when the entry is enriched again; I never hold the entry's words.
note: A light face, from the light round of 2026-11: one small thing beside one sentence, not a walk up to a test. Made by the working session (a child) in Enrichment/light-round-2026-11/, where the makers and data stay; placed here by the Concierge. No challenger read it. Every section is a proposal until Loudon approves it.

pieces.title: No one links here
pieces.caption: The eighteen pages no other page points to. Each may be a root or may be forgotten; the Weave is where that gets asked. By the page's own meaning the palace has no orphans: every one of these links outward. *What is real and what is a choice:* No typed link from another page, map build of 2026-11-09. Being unlinked is not being unused: Return Ceremony is on this sheet.

verdicts.file: Weave Ceremony — rich — no one links here.png
verdicts.why: Of the withdrawn piece, 'the quiet ones': It sits beside "Orphans: entries with no typed links in either direction" and shows none: the map has zero orphans and every page shown has at least two links out. "The sixteen with the fewest links" is not a defined set (1 page has 3 links, 9 have 4, 19 tie at 5; six of the 19 were taken alphabetically, unowned). And "quiet" is already this page's word for the opposite thing (Step 6.6: "high degree, no use in the window").
